classification.difficultyReason: Infer the narrow extension's width, add all boundary lengths and partition the figure into rectangles.

content.prompt: Find the perimeter and area of this figure.

spec.description: Unfilled rectilinear polygon with a narrow downward extension. All seven supplied edge labels are retained; the bottom edge remains unlabelled. Decorative blue outline is rendered in house black.
spec.mathematics: Clockwise edge lengths from the top-left are 5, 2, 2, 3, unknown, 2, 2 and 3 centimetres. Horizontal closure gives the bottom width as 1 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens appear; inferred lengths and decomposition are absent.

answer.short:
Perimeter: $20\text{ cm}$. Area: $15\text{ cm}^2$.

Find the missing width, then divide the figure into rectangles.
answer.worked:
The bottom edge has length $5-2-2=1\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Perimeter}&=5+2+2+3+1+2+2+3\\\text{Perimeter}&=20\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
Split the figure horizontally into three rectangles. Their dimensions are $5\text{ cm}\times2\text{ cm}$, $3\text{ cm}\times1\text{ cm}$ and $1\text{ cm}\times2\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Area}&=5\times2+3\times1+1\times2\\\text{Area}&=10+3+2\\\text{Area}&=15\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
